claimed_notes.intent_accuracy: share of the 2,300 labelled rows (dev 2,000 + dev_noisy 300) with the right intent
claimed_notes.macro_f1: intent macro-F1 over the same 2,300 rows
claimed_notes.action_accuracy: share of the 2,300 labelled rows with the right next action
claimed_notes.schema_valid_pct: per cent of all 2,309 answers (the 9 hostile rows included) that pass the grader's schema check
claimed_notes.top70_error_ratio: error rate on the 70% of rows with the highest confidence divided by the error rate on all rows; lower is better
claimed_notes.latency_p95_s: p95 of client-measured request time in seconds (latency_bench.json latency_ms.p95 / 1000): all 2,309 rows over HTTP, concurrency 8, Apple M1 laptop (macOS-26.5-arm64-arm-64bit), LLM step on, one uvicorn worker
claimed_notes.cost_per_message_usd: API list price per message at uncached rates, every prompt token at the full input price (MODELS.md: cache discounts are not credited to benchmark cost): the run's LLM cost over the 2,309 messages of the run (latency_bench.json llm cost / sample_count). At cached rates it was 4.06082e-05 USD per message.
